The drafted privacy and terms amendment covers every domain's rows: suggested changes, who can see them and their retention; in-app inbox retention (unread kept until read, 90 days after read); moderation; contribution counts; photo graduation; photos with location data refused (the browser removes it, the server checks); profile links; access-request retention; chat (Cloudflare as a processor, 30-day view, server retention); presence ('while you have the site open, every family member can see that you are online or idle, on your page and in chat; there is no invisible mode'); who has an account is visible to members; Turnstile on the join page; the Q2-04b outcome; and how to ask for something to be removed from the cloud, including the 35-day backup tail. io's answers are recorded verbatim with dates in the worklog and appended under 'Later clarifications' in DOC-2CFAE07B546C. The task keeps a per-question status table keyed by BRD2 id with its sheet item (answered or deferred); 'defaults ok' records the recommended default for every item io did not change, and a Q6 'strike <letter>' records that Q2-17 line as struck.

This task closes once the handoff is delivered and io's first reply is recorded. Each question has its own gate task (q2-01-approvers ... q2-15-web-parity) that closes when io's answer to that question is recorded, so an answered question unblocks its dependants at once and a deferred one blocks only its own dependants (BRD2 section 2.2).
